slides.sub: 3 local spots to know before your first weekend in town.

slides.title: Paper Plane Coffee Co.
slides.body: Seasonal drinks and beans to take home. Popular with Montclair State students.

slides.title: Eagle Rock Cafe
slides.body: A friendly neighborhood cafe with good coffee. A solid pick for a remote-work morning.

slides.title: The Corner
slides.body: Coffee and pastries, plus fresh juices and a breakfast and lunch menu.

slides.title: Your Montclair coffee stops
slides.tip: Before you make an offer, spend a Saturday morning in town. Walk a few blocks and time your commute.

caption:
Moving to Montclair? Your new favorite coffee is on this list.

Paper Plane Coffee Co. on N Fullerton Ave, Eagle Rock Cafe on Bellevue Ave, and The Corner on Grove St. Then walk a few blocks and time your commute before you make an offer.
